impact: 8 failures from raw DB::table('servers')->insert([...]) writing 'host' and 'group', which the servers table does not define - it has ip_address, and no group column. The tests were written against the upstream task-runner package's generic servers table, not dply's (the module is near-vendored). ConnectionManager::createFromModel() already reads $attributes['host'] ?? $attributes['ip_address'], so the product tolerates both shapes and nothing is broken; only the fixtures are wrong. Fix is to build servers through Server::factory() rather than raw inserts, which also satisfies the NOT NULL columns (organization_id, user_id) those inserts omit.
title: ConnectionManagerTest inserts a servers schema dply does not have
